about.howToUpdate: Agents: read this file before choosing work. When your PR finishes or changes a roadmap item, update that item's status/detail here in the same PR (keep ids; new items get a new id in their phase). Set about.main to the PR's version. Claude syncs this file with the live page the user edits; if they disagree, the live page wins.

decisions.ask: Which interaction and accessibility variant works for each part, and what time penalty is fair?
decisions.context: Short per-kind tests, time lost on failure, and testing versus merely labelling are approved. Exact inputs and timing are proposals.
decisions.question: How should the six part tests feel?

decisions.ask: What consumes a cable, how much night time does sorting cost, and what resolves a lost-cable claim?
decisions.context: One movable box, tangles on loose-cable moves, breakage and supplies are settled. Repair consumption, night-minute cost and the lost-cable customer are not built.
decisions.question: When does the cable box become repair work?

decisions.ask: One of A–D, keep the teal tiles, or a mix?

decisions.question: Which wall finish for the counter?

decisions.ask: How are travel/effort charged, cargo unloaded and identity/capacity kept across saves?
decisions.context: Physical searching, trunk capacity, probabilistic sites and refresh direction exist. Outings still use demo time (L4).
decisions.question: How does salvage join the main campaign?

decisions.ask: What should manual work, travel, voluntary closing, fatigue and overtime cost?
decisions.context: Day visitors are untimed; limited nights and manual pause are the direction. Some tests already charge time and respect 06:00.
decisions.question: What makes a night feel limited, but fair?

decisions.ask: Which payment, shipping, return and fee rules are needed for the first build-to-sale route?
decisions.context: Asynchronous listings, offers/questions, player prices and reputation influence are confirmed directions.

decisions.ask: What representative range is needed now, and which families justify later expansion?
decisions.context: Dozens of models per category and unique layouts are ambitions; the catalogue is user-led.

decisions.ask: What thresholds, discounts, guarantees, delays and fraud outcomes keep supply viable?
decisions.context: Stock/price variation, opening times, exclusives, hidden dishonesty and spend-unlocked bulk are confirmed. About 90% refers to immediately bulk-enabled suppliers being shady.
decisions.question: How risky and useful are suppliers?

decisions.ask: Which discoveries, remedies, delayed complaints and relationship costs make each scam distinct?
decisions.context: A/B/D/E/F/G/H accepted; C excluded. Some physical scam hooks exist.
decisions.question: How do shortcuts get discovered and matter?

decisions.ask: Which of airflow, fan-driven dust and liquid routing creates useful decisions?
decisions.context: Fans carrying loose dust remain queued. Heat/airflow and drawn liquid tubes were requested.
decisions.question: How deep should cooling and dust simulation go?

decisions.ask: What counts as new, when is failure rolled, and how does the player recover?
decisions.context: 1% daily failure after at least five protected days is recorded.

decisions.ask: Which upgrades belong in the slice, and what is automated only after the player learns it?
